justifications.durability: the new tests fail on regression - the run's negative control reddens test_the_guard_refuses_a_session_with_a_custom_basetemp and test_a_home_under_the_declared_root_is_a_throwaway_home, and my own independent mutation of the containment test at dispatch.py:1029 reddened tests/test_arming_guard_knows_a_test_session.py:140 when a home outside the declared root was wrongly refused.
justifications.evidence: the gate is recorded, not claimed - the run's logs/gate-base.log and logs/gate-head.log each end 14 passed EXIT=0 and logs/negative-control.log ends EXIT=1, and my independent re-run reproduced 4 passed and 14 passed.
justifications.fit: the four helpers sit beside the existing guard helpers in reckon/crew/dispatch.py:963-1051, reuse the module's Path/regex idiom, and the new test follows the repo's subprocess-and-mock pattern with no forbidden name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: dispatch.py:992-1030 reads the running session's declared --basetemp and returns the declared root when the home lies under it, so the guard now refuses a custom-basetemp home rather than standing down, which is the node goal.
